entities.summary: Muhammad Zahid Sheikh was a field hockey player who played for the Pakistan National Hockey Team from 1969 to 1976. He was born at Sialkot. He was capped 34 times and scored 8 goals. He is the Uncle of field hockey star Olympions Shahnaz Sheikh and Tariq Sheikh.
